jobs.title: developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Software Developer to join our growing team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high-quality software applications. You will work closely with team members to build reliable, user-friendly, and accessible digital solutions.

Responsibilities: Develop and maintain web applications, write clean and efficient code, troubleshoot technical issues, collaborate with designers and developers, and participate in testing and deployment.

Required Skills: Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Python or other programming languages, problem-solving skills, and effective communication.

We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and encourage candidates of all abilities to apply.
jobs.requirements: Strong core technical skills and passion for accessible engineering.
jobs.responsibilities: Develop accessible web user interfaces and collaborate with teams.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Develop speech recognition models and natural language processing interfaces for assistively-enabled software platforms.
jobs.requirements: Proficiency in Python, Web Speech API, natural language processing, intent classification algorithms, and modern JavaScript.
jobs.responsibilities: Train speech recognition models, build voice assistant command parsers, optimize speech synthesis, and write clean API code.
jobs.accessibilityInformation: Fully screen-reader compatible codebase, flexible working hours, voice dictation tooling provided, remote work support.

jobs.accessibilityInformation: Braille display hardware provided, screen reader software licenses covered.
